scope: Targeted public-source search for material and fracture data assignable to the General Electric CF6-80A2 engine and its Boeing 767 nacelle/cowling. No local source archive was scanned.

direct_facts: GE identifies the CF6-80A as a Boeing 767 and Airbus A310 engine family member.
The page gives configuration, dimensions and power information for the CF6-80A family.
sources.limitation: No component-specific alloy, layup, high-rate stress-strain curve, fracture surface, fracture energy, attachment failure or production cowling construction is published on the page.

direct_facts: The directive explicitly includes CF6-80A2 engines.
It refers to GE CF6-80A Service Bulletin 72-0869 for specified high-pressure turbine disks.
sources.limitation: The public directive identifies affected components and service actions, but does not provide a reusable material law, high-rate fracture surface, fracture energy or cowling attachment dataset.

sources.title: Conceptual design study of advanced acoustic-composite nacelles
direct_facts: The study describes a conceptual CF6-installation fan-cowl door using honeycomb, graphite, high-silica glass and Kevlar layers for a fire-resistance demonstration.
sources.limitation: The 1975 item is a conceptual technology study, not an identification of the production Boeing 767 CF6-80A2 nacelle or cowling. It supplies no assignable high-rate constitutive or attachment-fracture dataset.

sources.title: Design and Testing of Braided Composite Fan Case Materials and Components
direct_facts: The report concerns later braided-composite fan-case material and ballistic containment research.
sources.limitation: It is not a production CF6-80A2 component identification and cannot be substituted for the engine or cowling without an explicit traceable mapping.

derived_conclusion: The targeted official/manufacturer search adds adjacent design and regulatory context but no source-backed production CF6-80A2 engine/cowling material or fracture card.
